source: kinematic Core with explicit mesh-floor projection
notes: Version 3 fixes two synthetic geometric counterexamples to v2: a planted foot plus a foot moving 2 mm above the plane, and a vertex submerged below it. Surface contact uses a symmetric 0.1 mm numerical tolerance. The former 5 mm proximity metric remains reported, separately from surface contact. Speed, target, continuity and penetration limits are unchanged. This does not certify physical balance or naturalness. Qualification prompts and worlds are excluded from agent context.
